Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Landry Shamet?

Landry Shamet is 29 years old.

Where was Landry Shamet born?

Landry Shamet was born in Kansas City, Missouri.

When was Landry Shamet born?

Landry Shamet was born on March 13, 1997.

How tall is Landry Shamet?

Landry Shamet is 6-5 (196 cm) tall.

How much does Landry Shamet weigh?

Landry Shamet weighs 190 lbs (86 kg).

Is Landry Shamet in the Hall of Fame?

Landry Shamet is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Landry Shamet drafted?

Landry Shamet was drafted by Philadelphia 76ers, 1st round (26th pick, 26th overall), 2018 NBA Draft.

What position does Landry Shamet play?

Shooting Guard.

What is Landry Shamet's net worth?

Landry Shamet has made at least $32,947,106 playing professional basketball.

How much does Landry Shamet make?

Landry Shamet made $10,250,000 in 2024.

How many rings does Landry Shamet have?

Landry Shamet has won one championship.

What is Landry Shamet's Instagram account?

Landry Shamet is on Instagram at landryshamet.

What schools did Landry Shamet attend?

Landry Shamet attended Park Hill in Kansas City, Missouri and Wichita State.

What are Landry Shamet's nicknames?

Lanbo, One a Day are nicknames for Landry Shamet.
